title: Huawei pulls Mate 90 launch into September to face Apple, unveils Kirin 9050 with logic folding
summary: Huawei is moving its Mate 90 series launch from October to September, joining Apple's iPhone window with the Mate XT 2 tri-fold on 7 September and the standard Mate 90 lineup later in the month, according to leaks reported by Gizchina and Ofoki on 6 September. The series will be the first commercial device on the Kirin 9050 platform, which Huawei says uses a 'logic folding' dual-layer architecture to deliver a 53.5% transistor-density increase, a 37.5% area reduction and a 41% power-consumption cut against the Kirin 9030 Pro, manufactured by SMIC on DUV lithography.
